crossRefs.note: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and…
so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told…
Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues…

people.name: Agrippa
people.line: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea

people.name: Festus
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

translations.web: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”
translations.bsb: Then Agrippa said to Festus, “I would like to hear this man myself.” “Tomorrow you will hear him,” Festus declared.
translations.kjv: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
translations.asv: And Agrippa said unto Festus, I also could wish to hear the man myself. To-morrow, saith he, thou shalt hear him.
